days.title: Coastal Formations and Hiking
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: schwarze Steilküste
stops.detail: Arnarstapi is located on the south side of the Snæfellsjökull volcano and features a strikingly eroded black cliff coast with caves and rock arches.

stops.name: Wanderung in den Nachbarort Hellnar
stops.detail: These can be seen particularly well on an approximately 3 km long hike to the neighboring village of Hellnar.

stops.name: Basaltsäulen am Strand
stops.detail: The sea at Arnarstapi has reshaped the basalt columns on the beach and formed a wide variety of bays and caves that extend beneath the cliffs.

stops.name: Statue von Ragnar Kjartansson
stops.detail: By the sea stands a statue by Ragnar Kjartansson, which represents the legendary figure Bárður Snæfellsás.

stops.name: geschützte Landeplätze für Ruderboote
stops.detail: Since the Middle Ages, this has been an important fishing spot, especially as Arnarstapi had several protected landing sites for rowboats.
